description_full: MIXUE Group operates as a drinks company in Chinese mainland. The company offers freshly made fruit drinks, tea drinks, ice cream, coffee and fresh beer under MIXUE, Lucky Cup, and FULU brand names. It also provides syrups, milk, tea, coffee, fruit, grains, and condiments. In addition, the company engages in the operation of sales of goods and equipment to franchisees, as well as provision of franchise and related services. MIXUE Group was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Zhengzhou, the People's Republic of China.

financial_summary: MIXUE GROUP is a mid-cap consumer defensive business with a $2.1B market cap on $5.0B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +32% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 85% against a 9% cost of capital — a 76-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat, with gross margins sitting at 30%.

The business throws off $803M in free cash flow — roughly 16 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.03× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Net dilution runs at 25.6% annually, transferring value from owners to stock-based comp, and within its sector the business captures 2.7× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
